explanation: Encodes the claimed constant "C = 1.4....." as an answer value with |C − 1.4| < 0.1 and a(n) ~ C·log²(n). The OEIS text "1.4....." suggests C ∈ [1.4, 1.5), while the formalization allows (1.3, 1.5), which is slightly looser. That is a reasonable reading of an imprecise numerical claim. The asymptotic is genuinely unresolved, so this is severity 1.
